messages:
Emma (Brightside): hi team — after the RBAC refactor earlier today our CI started failing deploying models. getting 403 `models.deploy` against service account svc-bsp-deployer@brightside. Any idea?
Sam (Support): hey emma — can you paste the exact error and the deploy job id?
Emma (Brightside): job 2026-03-20T14:10Z, error: `403 PermissionDenied: Caller does not have permission to call models.deploy on resource projects/bsp/models/retail-v2` logs show principal `svc-bsp-deployer@brightside`
Sam (Support): thx. pinging Eng-Sec and Infra — @Raj @Olivia, looks like role bindings might have drifted after yesterday's roles flattening rollout.
Raj (Eng-Sec): seeing similar 403s from other customers. quick check: audit log shows `denied` for `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` and missing `redwood.models.deploy` custom role binding. possible mapping change during the refactor.
Olivia (Eng-Infra): checked the migration PR — we collapsed `model-deployer` -> `service-deploy` groups but didn't backfill service account bindings for tenants using tenant-scoped service identities. rolling a hotfix to add the legacy binding back.
DeployBot: deploy started: infra/hotfix/attach-legacy-binding to prod-cluster-3 — build 4821
Sam (Support): temporary workaround for Brightside: we can grant `roles/redwood.modelDeployer` to `svc-bsp-deployer@brightside` manually. Want us to apply?
Emma (Brightside): please do, hitting production release windows.
Olivia (Eng-Infra): applied manual binding at 14:21Z: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding bsp --member=serviceAccount:svc-bsp-deployer@brightside --role=roles/redwood.modelDeployer`
Emma (Brightside): confirm deploy is back to green. thanks! :tada:
Sam (Support): leaving this open until eng confirms the permanent fix.
Raj (Eng-Sec): root cause: during RBAC flatten we removed group-to-role inheritance for tenant service accounts; the migration script missed accounts created via the old `svc-tool` path. Also saw KMS deny log for `cryptoKeys.get` (same SA) — their encrypted model weights couldn't be read during deploy. KMS policy lacked `cryptoKeyDecrypt` on key `projects/bsp/locations/us/keyRings/models/keys/weights-main`.
Olivia (Eng-Infra): fixed KMS bindings and updated migration to detect service account patterns; pushed PR 4923 which: 
```
- adds back model-deployer binding for legacy SAs
- ensures kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter role for model-serving keys to affected SAs
- adds smoke test that runs a model deploy with KMS fetch
```
Raj (Eng-Sec): we also rotated the service account token as precaution and recorded audit event `sa.rotation` in the tenant audit stream.
Tara (Support Manager): thanks team — can we summarize for Brightside and include timelines + remediation steps?
Sam (Support): will send postmortem snippet to Brightside and attach the migration PR. ETA on permanent deploy: 1h for rollout and verification.
Emma (Brightside): appreciate the quick response. any follow-up for our infra?
Olivia (Eng-Infra): no action required on your side; we'll notify if we need to touch your service accounts. We'll run a scan and provide list of SAs we touched.
Raj (Eng-Sec): short-term mitigation added: policy alert that fires on `models.deploy` 403 spikes and KMS 403s per-tenant. long-term: we will add a preflight check in the RBAC refactor CI.
Sam (Support): closing loop: manual binding applied, KMS perms fixed, PR merged, rollback not needed. tagging as resolved in support ticket. :white_check_mark:
Emma (Brightside): confirmed all good from our side. closing. :white_check_mark:
